main.description: Decline an invitation addressed to the caller. Nothing is written to the community's repo and no moderation action is logged.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: Authentication is required; sign in before retrying.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The request is incomplete or malformed: invitation is empty, expectedVersion is negative or idempotencyKey is empty or too long; correct it before retrying.

errors.name: InvitationNotFound
errors.description: No invitation with this ID is addressed to the caller.

errors.name: InvitationLapsed
errors.description: The invitation lapsed 14 days after it was made.

errors.name: InvitationNotOpen
errors.description: The invitation was already accepted, declined, or replaced by a newer invitation.

errors.name: StateConflict
errors.description: expectedVersion is not the community's current roster version, or the indexed roster is behind the community's repo; refetch the roster version before retrying.

errors.name: IdempotencyConflict
errors.description: The same key was reused with a different request; do not retry with that key.

errors.name: ModerationUnavailable
errors.description: The moderation service or the community's repo is temporarily unavailable; retry later with the same idempotency key.

expectedVersion.description: The community's roster version the caller expects; listViewerInvitations serves it with each invitation

idempotencyKey.description: Opaque key that makes a retry of the same request return its first result; scoped to the caller and the community
